title: Patient Concern or Grievance
about: For a patient to raise a concern or a grievance, including unfair treatment. Keeps what 45 CFR 92.8(c) asks a Section 1557 grievance record to hold; keep it three years after it is resolved.

source.name: Section 1557 grievance procedures and records, 45 CFR 92.8(c)

licence.terms: GPL-3.0-or-later, as the module. Adapt it for your clinic.

blocks.text: Tell us about a problem so we can fix it. You may leave your name off, but then we cannot reply to you.

fields.label: Phone or email to reach you

blocks.label: What it is about (tick all that apply)
items: Access or help for a disability
I was treated unfairly because of my race, color, national origin, language, sex, age or disability

fields.label: Who was involved, if you know

blocks.label: What would you like us to do?

blocks.text: We keep your name private, except as the law requires or to look into your concern. We will not treat you differently for telling us.

Our Section 1557 Coordinator, named below, handles concerns about unfair treatment. You can also file a civil rights complaint with the U.S. Department of Health and Human Services, Office for Civil Rights, at ocrportal.hhs.gov or 1-800-368-1019 (TDD 1-800-537-7697), usually within 180 days.
Keep this record for at least three years after the grievance is resolved.
